fields.Name: T314 - Scheduling Create Job Slideout
fields.Description: Exercises the generic ScheduledJobSlidePanel + ScheduledJobEditor create form (cron/timezone/concurrency scheduling inputs) — a custom slide-in editor, not the generated entity form used elsewhere.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Jobs' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Click the 'New Job' button (plus icon) in the header. A slide-in panel titled for a new scheduled job should open, containing an editor form with a General section (Name, Description, Job Type, Status), a Schedule section with a 'Cron Expression' text field (hint: 'second minute hour day month weekday'), a Timezone dropdown and a Concurrency dropdown, plus a Configuration JSON area and Notification toggles. Success is the create form rendering with the Cron Expression and Concurrency fields visible — you do NOT need to actually create a job. You may close/Cancel the panel afterward.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'New Job' opens a slide-in editor panel
The editor shows the Schedule section with a Cron Expression field, a Timezone dropdown, and a Concurrency dropdown (plus Name/Job Type in the General section)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
